general_feeling: A bit uncomfortable initially, but after a couple of days it was fine.
challenges: Just that I believe the quality of the glass used in the glasses could be better. Like, it could have been more clear.
beh_adapt: Had to get used to wearing glasses as I am not used to wearing one. But then it becomes normal/usual after a couple of days
improvements: Initially it is a bit uncomfortable for someone who is not used to wearing glasses. So, may be the part that is around the nose could be more soft by using some soft paddings.  And may be to have a sensor mounted on soft band that we can wear around our heads. I believe it would be more comfortable to wear a band, with a sensor mounted on it, around our heads.
